final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts` and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` following the rules in README.md. All 3 tests in `npm test` pass.

I also checked the README examples and error cases by hand: `"80, 443,8080 - 8090,8091"` normalizes to `"80,443,8080-8091"`, `10-20,21-30` merges to `10-30`, `10-20,22-30` stays apart, and malformed inputs throw.

The three functions share one internal parser, so they apply the same validation and merging. `tsc` isn't installed and the npm registry returned 403, so I couldn't run a type check. The code uses only strict-safe types, but it's unverified by the compiler.
